about: The questions the memory audit of 9 Nov found threads asking again and again, each with the file that answers it and the terms that carry the answer. test/notes-questions.test.mjs reads them against their homes; a fresh reader is asked them to show a session with memory off finds the answers.

questions.q: A thread needs to undo a commit it already pushed, or delete a branch it made. What will be refused, and what does it do instead?
A change adds a new file and the plugin tests do not see it. Why, and what fixes it?
A test run is going in the background. May the thread switch branches in that checkout meanwhile?
What fails when a thread uses /mnt/project-files for links, git repos or shared files?
A thread waits on CI and nothing happens, or its gates read files already on main as the PR's own. What is going on?
A verifier runs node with a tap reporter over three test files and only one runs, or a claude -p reader ignores its prompt. Why?
May a verifier commit a session transcript as evidence?
How does a verifier show what the PR's base did when ci checks out at depth 1?
How does each stage agent get its brief, and what does the hook need to return in auto mode and under claude -p?
Can the SubagentStart hook always read the agent's brief from its transcript?
Why can a named stage agent not load the return tool, and where is its served model read from?
How does a headless claude -p sign in from the container, and how is its memory turned off?
